plaques.text:
TARNHALL

Seven neighbourhoods came up the water every Long Light to feast here.

pickups.label: Pry up what the byre floor holds

edges.doc: tools/audit_edges.py: the porch and the bridge are floors; the RIME ice is a floor over the tarn and the fjord head; the hall's front doors are a wall in RIME (barred).
